gallery.heading: One seed. One question.
gallery.intro: Choose a configuration, observe the model and download its data. Every recipe has an explicit seed, profile and parameters.
gallery.limits: Exploratory models, without species calibration. A hypothesis may produce no difference over this interval. Compare observations from the same model day and Viveiro version.
gallery.empty: There are no experiments in this selection yet. Change the filters or contribute a scenario.
gallery.contributeText: Submit the question, plan and method for review. Credits identify the origin of each recipe.
gallery.loaded: Gallery recipe: {title} · version {version}. The configuration is ready for you to run.
gallery.notFound: Gallery recipe not found. The default configuration was kept; choose another recipe or edit the JSON.
gallery.question: Question
gallery.portable: Experiments open in the isolated laboratory. The JSON plan also runs in the CLI with the same version and numerical policy.
gallery.entry.trilhas-sem-vento.title: Trails in still air
gallery.entry.trilhas-sem-vento.question: How do trails organize without wind transport?
gallery.entry.trilhas-sem-vento.conditio: Wind X = 0; compare with the wind recipe using the same seed.
gallery.entry.trilhas-com-vento.title: Trails with wind
gallery.entry.trilhas-com-vento.question: Does signal transport change exploration and observations?
gallery.entry.trilhas-com-vento.conditio: Wind X = 1.5 u.; other parameters match the still-air recipe.
gallery.entry.solo-deslizante.title: More sliding soil
gallery.entry.solo-deslizante.question: Does the angle of repose affect excavation stability?
gallery.entry.solo-resistente.title: More resistant soil
gallery.entry.solo-resistente.question: How do galleries develop with a higher angle of repose?
gallery.entry.solo-resistente.condition: Repose angle 55°; same seed as the more sliding soil.
gallery.entry.prole-fria.title: Brood in a cold environment
gallery.entry.prole-fria.question: How does cold affect development and activity in the model?
gallery.entry.prole-fria.condition: Air at 18 °C. Soil temperature responds to the environment.
gallery.entry.prole-quente.title: Brood in a warm environment
gallery.entry.prole-quente.question: Do observations change when air temperature rises?
gallery.entry.prole-quente.condition: Air at 28 °C; same seed as the cold recipe.
gallery.entry.fundacao-claustral.title: Founding from reserves
gallery.entry.fundacao-claustral.questio: How does a queen fund the first generation from finite reserves?
gallery.entry.fundacao-claustral.conditi: Demonstration claustral profile; three days may show only early founding.
gallery.entry.fundacao-semiclaustral.que: How does external foraging contribute to the founding budget?
gallery.entry.fundacao-semiclaustral.con: Demonstration semiclaustral profile. Compare strategies; these are not calibrated species profiles.
gallery.entry.reserva-pequena.title: Starting with a small reserve
gallery.entry.reserva-pequena.question: How does a smaller initial stock affect colony observations?
gallery.entry.reserva-ampla.title: Starting with a larger reserve
gallery.entry.reserva-ampla.question: What changes with more food available at the same start?
gallery.entry.reserva-ampla.condition: Initial stock 25 u.; same seed as the small-reserve recipe.
